basis.semantics: Establishes the two completion facts of the single Issue 170 live qualification from durable originals only, and never mints that attempt's authority. read_promotion_receipt, verify_campaign_consumption, validate_campaign_consumption and completion_facts are actual lifecycle validators over a whole append-only consumption chain and the promotion receipt that attempt emitted; completion_facts grants exactly fresh_live_attempt_consumed_once and terminal_live_result_preserved, which are two of the twelve fixed campaign requirements, so this module carries real authority over live facts and a supporting-contract route would misstate it. The durable chain is the anti-forgery anchor: consumption.read_store replays the on-disk MAC chain under its own lock, so a caller cannot present a receipt the store does not already hold, and _terminal_event rebuilds the exact event consumption.record_outcome appended and requires its canonical digest to equal the replayed tip, which a forgery could reach only through a SHA-256 preimage. _claim_snapshot requires the retained claim receipt to be that chain's immediate predecessor at sequence minus one with status CLAIMED and identical store, binding, phase and claim. validate_campaign_consumption re-derives the whole report from the same originals and requires equality, so a caller-supplied report can never reseal itself. Issuance is unforgeable by construction: ValidatedLiveAttempt is frozen, completion_facts refuses any value this reader did not itself issue, _issued re-reads the issued-object registry against a live weak reference, the owning pid and a recomputed fingerprint, and register_at_fork clears all issuance in a child so a forked process holds no facts. Receipt custody is read through one descriptor opened O_NOFOLLOW and requires a regular file owned by root or this user, no group or other write bits, exactly one link, non-empty and at most 64 KiB, then re-stats to require unchanged mode, size, mtime and ctime and identical device and inode, so a link swap or in-place edit during the read refuses. The promotion receipt contract is closed to exactly eight fields with a fixed schema and regex-bounded status, ticket, repair branch, commit and digests, decoding rejects duplicate JSON keys and non-canonical values, and the receipt must name the durable post-cachebuster generation by both package digest and version, so a receipt from any other generation is refused and pre and post package digests must actually differ. A terminal failure is preserved as faithfully as a success: the non-receipt branch stays open for failure evidence only, success without a promotion receipt refuses, and success must agree with a PASS receipt status. The issued report fixes campaign, release, live, qualification and promotion authority to false, records single_consumption_required with retry_permitted false, and this reader performs no effect, takes no callback and consumes nothing itself; git ancestry, branch and ticket evidence stay with the promotion preflight and host custody stays with host_attestation. basis.semantics: Establishes the production-campaign completion facts of the fixed Issue 170 gate from one durable, keyed store only, and mints none of that campaign's authority. verify_production_campaign, validate_production_campaign and completion_facts are actual lifecycle validators over a whole sealed store and the caller-retained anchor its producer minted, and completion_facts grants up to nine of the twelve fixed campaign requirements, so this module carries real authority over campaign facts and a supporting-contract route would misstate it. The keyed anchor is the anti-forgery trust anchor, because store content and the generation are both available to a forger: the producer mints an HMAC-SHA256 key when it creates the store, MACs every evidence record and the report body under it, and hands the anchor back out of band, so _campaign_anchor takes the key from the caller and never reads it from the store. The reader re-derives rather than reads: _generation_rows rebuilds the obligation table from the retained generation, _evidence_records re-reads every sealed file through an owner-verified descriptor and recomputes each closing digest from the bytes on disk, and the report must name that exact table and closure by obligation_table_sha256 and closure_sha256 or refuse, so a report is never its own evidence. validate_production_campaign rebuilds the whole reading before comparing, so a supplied report cannot reseal itself, and report_sha256 covers transport integrity only while campaign_mac carries the force. The nine fact names are never returned from a literal: _gate_facts reads completion_gate.FACT_COMPONENTS at verify time and _anchor_plan requires the declared FACT_ROW_ANCHORS key set to equal that gate-derived set exactly, every declared class to resolve to at least one rebuilt row, and exactly one capstone anchored to the whole table, so an added, removed or renamed gate fact fails closed instead of silently earning a grant. Issuance is unforgeable by construction: ValidatedProductionCampaign is frozen and carries a private authority object, completion_facts refuses any value this reader did not itself issue, _issued re-reads the issuance registry against a live weak reference, the owning pid and a recomputed fingerprint, requires the granted tuple to equal what verify actually derived rather than what the report asserts, and register_at_fork clears all issuance in a child. Store custody is one descriptor per file opened O_NOFOLLOW and O_CLOEXEC under a directory this user or root owns with no group or other write bits, requiring a regular file with exactly one link and bounded extent, re-stating mode, size, mtime and ctime and the device and inode after the read so a link swap or in-place edit refuses; _store_inventory refuses any store-root entry beside report.json and evidence/, _store_identity binds the one instance read so a byte-identical clone refuses at a second path, and strict decoding rejects duplicate JSON keys and non-canonical values. The issued report fixes campaign_credit, release_authorized, qualification_authorized and promotion_authorized to false, and the module performs no effect, takes no callback and consumes nothing itself. Two limits stay open and are stated rather than closed: a caller that mints its own anchor and execution identity can author a complete store from the generation alone, so the reader publishes execution_sha256 with its dispatch_sha256, pid, started_ns and nonce components and store_sha256 precisely so the gate can cross-check each against the side that owns it and refuse replay, and _refuse_key_material stops only the accidental and verbatim key-in-store cases while key custody remains the producing lane's obligation.
